author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
- The prompt's Inputs section described a `<patient>` block (and said "three blocks" while listing two) that the route never sends.
- The model learns who the patient is from the identity line repeated at the top of each retrieved chunk, so the prompt now says exactly that.
- Removed the matching "Known gaps" entry from the README.

## Test plan
- [x] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean
- [x] `pytest -q`: 214 passed (unit-only, no model call)
- [ ] Live retrieval check (`rag_pipeline.ingest` + a real `/ask`) not run; needs Postgres and billable OpenRouter calls
